standing_rules: Omit literal OVMS-AGENT> from lines intended to paste into OVMS Agent.
GitHub is the development control plane/source of truth; VAX/OpenVMS is authoritative for DEC C/VAX, RMS, DCL and runtime acceptance.
Use GITAUTH as the standing prompt-free raw Git network path on VAX/OpenVMS after installing/loading SYS$LOGIN:OVMS_AGENT_GIT_AUTH.COM.
Do not use credential.helper=store, the rejected global credential.helper experiment, or askpass as the standing VAX Git authentication solution.
Do not treat an odd VAX Git status alone as proof that a remote operation occurred; require visible Git network/ref output and directly verify remote mutations on GitHub.
Unshallow a shallow acceptance clone and verify ancestry before using it to promote a milestone branch to main.
Repository filenames should be uppercase by default unless a concrete external/tooling blocker requires lowercase.
Keep only the two most recently completed milestone development branches after promotion, with permanent milestone tags before pruning older completed branches.
